title: An optogenetic proximity labeling approach to probe the composition of inducible biomolecular condensates in cultured cells
protocol: Introduce the gene of interest into the pCDNA5_FRT-TO_TurboID-mCherry-Cry2 plasmid.
Sub-clone the cDNA encoding the protein of interest into the KpnI site of the vector using the In-Fusion HD cloning system.
Follow manufacturer’s guidelines for detailed protocol and primer design instructions.
Thaw the Flp-In™T-REx™293 cell line several days before transfection day.
Maintain the cell line in medium containing Zeocin (100 μg/mL) and blasticidin (15 μg/mL).
Transfect the construct transiently to verify expression and localization of protein of interest.
Transfect Flp-In™ T-REx™ 293 using Lipofectamine™ 2000 Reagent as per the manufacturer’s instructions.
Verify expression of the protein of interest by Western blotting using an anti-mCherry antibody or a specific antibody against the protein.
Verify intracellular localization of the protein of interest using standard fluorescence microscopy.
Transfect Flp-In™T-REx™293 cells using Lipofectamine™ 2000 Reagent.
Select stable transfectants using 100–200 μg/mL hygromycin B.
Pool all the hygromycin resistant foci after 6–8 weeks of selection.
Grow cells until 70–80% confluence, harvest and freeze early-passage cells in multiple vials.
Place cell vials in liquid nitrogen for long-term cryopreservation.
Induce expression of gene of interest with doxycycline to a final concentration of 2 μg/mL.
Incubate cells for 16 h to 24 h at 37°C.
Place plates in the illumination box inside a CO2 incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for optogenetic activation.
Apply multiple light-dark cycles using 4 s of light followed by 10 s of dark for 3 min.
Process the samples for whole cell extraction or fixation and immunostaining using standard procedures.
Incubate whole-cell extracts from Flp-In™T-REx™293 cells expressing stably TurboID-TopBP1-mCherry-Cry2 with 2 μg/mL doxycycline for 24 h, as indicated.
Reveal the expression level of the doxycycline-inducible protein by immunoblot analysis.
Obtain representative fluorescence images of cells expressing TurboID-TopBP1-mCherry-Cry2 before and after optogenetic activation with cycles of 4 s light (488 nm)-10 s resting for 3 min.
Stain DNA in the cells with Hoechst 33258.
Prewarm cell media, PBS, and trypsin at 37°C in a water bath.
Seed 4 × 10^6 Flp-InTMT-RExTM293 cells per 10 cm dish in 5 mL of DMEM medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) without any selection antibiotics.
Add 4 μg/mL of doxycycline to a falcon tube containing 5 mL of DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS, reaching a final concentration of 2 μg/mL doxycycline.
Add the 5 mL cell culture with 2 μg/mL doxycycline to the cells in the dish.
Allow protein expression for 16–24 hours.
Prewarm DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS at 37°C.
Thaw biotin stock solution.
Prepare 10 mL of DMEM supplemented with 500 μM biotin in a 15 mL Falcon tube and keep it at 37°C.
Replace the cell culture medium with 10 mL of DMEM media supplemented with 500 μM biotin and 2 μg/mL doxycycline, adding from the wall of the dish to avoid cell detachment.
Transfer rapidly the cell culture dish without cover into a custom-made illumination box in a humidified 37°C incubator with 5% CO2.
Turn ON the illumination device.
Expose the cells to blue light for 10 min of light-dark cycles (4 s light followed by 30 s dark).
Remove medium completely by aspiration.
Wash the cells carefully with 5 mL of 1× PBS per dish at 18°C–25°C.
Gently scrape all cells off the plate and place the cell suspension in a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Keep the cell suspension on ice.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 3 min.
Aspirate the medium from the pellet.
Freeze the pellet at -80°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 μL of RIPA/SDS Lysis buffer supplemented with 1X complete protease and phosphatase inhibitors and 250 U benzonase.
Transfer the lysate into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Incubate the lysate on a rotating wheel for 1 h at 4°C.
Sonicate the lysate on ice using a sonicator (40% amplitude, 3 cycles of 10 s sonication and 2 s resting).
Clean the sonicator probe between samples to avoid cross-contamination.
Spin down cellular debris at 16000 × g for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Prepare agarose-streptavidin (50 μl of beads per condition) during centrifugation.
Resuspend streptavidin beads by gently tapping the tube.
Wash beads twice with RIPA/SDS lysis buffer and resuspend in RIPA/SDS buffer.
Transfer cleared supernatant to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Determine total protein concentration using Bradford assay.
Incubate up to 1 mg of cell lysates with pre-washed agarose-streptavidin beads for 3 hours on a rotating wheel at 4°C.
Centrifuge bead suspensions for 1 minute at 400 × g, at 18°C–25°C.
Remove supernatant carefully by pipetting.
Wash beads with 1 mL of RIPA/SDS lysis buffer and incubate on a rotating wheel for 3 minutes.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 400 × g, remove supernatant carefully.
Wash beads with 1 mL Wash Buffer 1 and incubate on a rotating wheel for 3 minutes.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 400 × g, remove supernatant carefully.
Wash beads with 1 mL Wash Buffer 2 and incubate on a rotating wheel for 3 minutes.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 400 × g, remove supernatant carefully.
Wash beads with 1 mL Wash Buffer 3 and incubate on a rotating wheel for 3 minutes.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 400 × g, remove supernatant carefully.
Wash beads twice with 1 mL Wash Buffer 4 and incubate on a rotating wheel for 3 minutes each time.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 400 × g after each wash step; remove supernatant carefully.
Add 60 μL of 2X Laemmli Sample buffer to each sample and flick to mix.
Heat samples for 10 minutes at 95°C to elute proteins.
Store samples at -20°C or -80°C for at least 1 year.
Avoid multiple boiling and freezing cycles of the samples.
Resolve proteins by SDS-polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (SDS-PAGE).
Load 2-4 μg of proteins in the “Input” control well for western blot analysis.
Use up to 2 mg of proteins isolated by streptavidin pull down for mass spectrometry analyses.
Analyze raw mass spectrometry data using MaxQuant software with standard settings.
Use Perseus for graphical representation and statistical analysis.
Perform a standard t test to evaluate differences in protein abundance between samples.
